envelope.description: Record a store failure once and raise it by name

body.title: Record a store failure once and raise it by name
body.summary: Add the health record, getStoreHealth, recordStoreFailureIfLockError and the error LmdbStoreLocksLostError to the store module. withWriteTxnSync confirms a code 22 or -30775 failure with a probe read before recording. withWriteTxn bounds its wait at 10 seconds, probes with a read, records and rejects when the probe throws -30775, and goes on waiting when the probe returns. Once the record is locks-lost, getGraphStore throws the named error and closeGraphStore resolves without calling the library's close.
acceptanceChecks: On the broken store from t3, withWriteTxn records locks-lost through its probe within the bound (shortened for the test) and rejects with the named error
On the same store withWriteTxnSync records at once; a code 22 failure whose probe read succeeds is rethrown and leaves the record ok
The named error's message names another process and does not contain 'semume'
After locks-lost, getGraphStore rejects with the named error and closeGraphStore resolves without calling the library
On a healthy temporary store, a transaction whose callback is held open past the shortened bound is not recorded as a failure: the probe is observed to run and to return, and the write then completes

tests.name: detection through the real wrappers: asynchronous write by probe, synchronous write at once
health record: after locks-lost a further store call throws the named error and closeGraphStore skips the library's close
health record: after locks-lost getGraphStore itself rejects with the named error
sync wrapper: code 22 with a succeeding probe read is rethrown and leaves the record ok
slow healthy write: the probe runs and returns, nothing is recorded, the write completes
